newsitem.title: INDIA: Cyclone fears boost Indian castor prices.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone fears boost Indian castor prices.

text.p: A powerful cyclone set to strike India's southeastern coast on Wednesday night boosted castorseed March delivery prices, dealers said.
They said prices rose on fears that crops would be affected if the cyclone, expected to cross Andhra Pradesh coast, also hit producing centres in the southern coast.
"However later on the rally eased as the cyclone is now seen not crossing the south and March delivery dropped again to 1,131/1,132 rupees per quintal," one dealer said.
Groundnut oil slid modestly to 343/344 rupees per 10 kg from 345/346 as fresh buying fell.
